summary: Implementation plan for (1) displaying explicit conflict/review reasons in the Prüfen & Korrigieren tab, (2) eliminating empty VIP stream covers without valid file_ids from catalog/playlists and cleaning up orphan D1 entries, (3) replacing false SKIPPED_DUPLICATE rejections with smart Episode/Movie UPSERT while preserving multi-quality stream selection, and (4) prioritizing filename episode numbers over caption typos (e.g. Queen of the South S01E13.mp4 vs S01E3) with numeric message_id normalization.
